input.summary: Limit the Monthly Base Fee sourcing commitment to the current 12-month period, with a 30-day reduction right and a true-up instead of a shortfall penalty.
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot take a minimum-fee commitment locked for the full eight-year Term with no way to descope. We have limited the commitment to the then-current twelve-month period and added a 30 days' notice reduction right with a true-up rather than a shortfall penalty, consistent with our fallback position.

ops.oldText: Customer agrees that, during the Term, Customer shall be required to obtain from M&I all of those Services
ops.newText: Customer agrees that, during the then-current twelve (12) month period of the Term only, Customer shall be required to obtain from M&I all of those Services

ops.text: Customer may reduce the Services included in the Monthly Base Fee, and the corresponding Monthly Base Fee commitment, upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to M&I. Any resulting shortfall shall be handled solely through a true-up of the Monthly Base Fee to the Services actually ordered and used, and not as a penalty.
